Priyanka Chopra's daughter Malti Marie celebrates Raksha Bandhan

Priyanka Chopra Jonas's daughter, Malti Marie Chopra Jonas, celebrated her first Raksha Bandhan by tying a Rakhi to her cousin, Neer. Parineeti Chopra shared glimpses of the celebration on social media, posting a picture of Malti Marie with Neer and captioning it, 'Didi loves you.' The event marked a significant family occasion for the Chopra family.
